instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: International development NGO implementing water, sanitation, and hygiene programs across 6 countries in sub-Saharan Africa. Annual program budget of €15M funded by institutional donors including EU, USAID, and bilateral agencies. The organization focuses heavily on optimizing resource distribution to maximize impact per donor dollar while maintaining high operational standards for project delivery.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. This streamlined the transition from beneficiary registration to program activation, demonstrating early success in improving administrative efficiency and reducing field staff paperwork.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has challenged us to improve EBITDA margins by 500 basis points within 3 years. This requires a disciplined, data-driven approach to identifying cost drivers and process bottlenecks. We are open to technology investment if it demonstrably reduces unit costs or eliminates manual touchpoints, but every project must have a clear ROI timeline of under 12 months.
answers.additionalContext: The field operations are highly decentralized across various remote locations, making standardized technological deployment challenging. Donor compliance requirements often necessitate rigid procurement cycles that conflict with agile innovation timelines.
answers.teamSize: Our team includes 3 backend developers, 1 frontend developer, and 1 QA engineer, managed by the CTO who also acts as product owner. We outsource UI/UX design to a freelance designer as needed. The team can handle incremental product improvements but struggles to carve out focused time for larger innovation bets without compromising current sprint commitments.

opportunities.title: Field Data Automation Pilot
opportunities.rationale: Implement low-cost mobile forms and automated data pipelines to replace manual paper reporting from field staff. This is a high-impact, conservative efficiency gain that directly addresses process bottlenecks.

first_actions: Identify 2 key operational processes for digitization.
Select and procure open-source mobile form platform (e.g., KoboToolbox or ODK).
Pilot deployment with 10 field staff in one country.
resources_needed: Backfill time for the designated product owner
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction of manual data entry time by 40% within 6 months.
milestones: Platform selection and vendor contract signed (Month 1).
Pilot launch and data collection complete (Month 3).
Full rollout plan defined for next quarter (Month 4).

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Resource Allocation Engine (Bold)
opportunities.rationale: Develop a machine learning model that predicts regional needs for water/sanitation interventions based on satellite imagery and health data. This bold shift moves the organization from reactive distribution to predictive, high-efficiency allocation.

first_actions: Conduct feasibility study for integrating satellite imagery APIs (e.g., Sentinel).
Identify 1 existing ML talent or partner externally.
Define MVP metrics focusing on cost savings per intervention.
resources_needed: Data science consultancy fees ($50k - $100k, outside budget)
Time allocation for a dedicated 'Innovation Lead' volunteer/part-time hire
execution_plan.success_metric: Demonstrate 15% reduction in logistical overhead costs within 12 months.
milestones: Feasibility study completion and business case approval (Month 6).
MVP model trained and tested on pilot data (Month 9).
Integration into quarterly budget planning for next cycle (Month 10).

next_steps.action: Conduct a comprehensive process mapping workshop focused on the top three cost drivers.
Allocate dedicated 'Innovation Time' (10% capacity) for the backend development team, explicitly protecting it from operational demands.
Develop a detailed ROI model and resource estimate for the Field Data Automation Pilot (Incremental Opportunity).

key_weaknesses: Over-reliance on owner-alone decision-making, leading to potential bottleneck and lack of cross-functional alignment.
Severe talent constraint: The lean team struggles to dedicate necessary focused time for large innovation bets without jeopardizing critical operational commitments.
Process rigidity: Existing compliance and procurement cycles are too slow to adapt to short-horizon, high-impact efficiency initiatives.
Low budget allocation (4%): Insufficient capital available for both incremental process improvements and high-risk radical technology exploration.
